Stockfish.js 19.0.1

Upstream release:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1

Corresponding source:
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v19.0.1
https://github.com/official-stockfish/Stockfish/tree/sf_19

The pinned stockfish.js checkout includes the C++ engine, src/emscripten
glue, and build.js. The Stockfish sf_19 link is the base engine reference,
not a substitute for the stockfish.js source and build scripts.

Build procedure from the v19.0.1 upstream README:
- Install and activate Emscripten 6.0.9 and make Node.js available.
- In the pinned stockfish.js checkout, run ./build.js --all.
- Outputs are written to src/; use the single-threaded full JS/WASM pair
  and rename stockfish-19-asm.js to lib/stockfish-local.js for fallback.
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/blob/v19.0.1/build.js
https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/blob/v19.0.1/README.md

- ../../lib/stockfish-local.js

These SHA-256 values are retained provenance records, not verification
of a newly built package, its signature, or a byte-identical rebuild.
